statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(pwd | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); model_info=""; if [ -n "$model_name" ]; then model_short=$(echo "$model_name" | sed -E 's/Claude ([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*) (Sonnet|Opus|Haiku).*/\2-\1/' | sed 's/Sonnet/sonnet/' | sed 's/Opus/Opus/' | sed 's/Haiku/Haiku/'); model_info=$(printf '\033[34m[%s]\033[0m ' "$model_short"); fi; git_info=""; if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ]; then unstaged=""; ! git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null && unstaged="*"; staged=""; ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null && staged="+"; git_info=$(printf '\033[35m[\033[32m%s\033[31m%s\033[33m%s\033[35m]\033[0m ' "$branch" "$unstaged" "$staged"); fi; fi; context_info=""; total_input=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); total_output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // empty'); ctx_size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // empty'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$total_input" ] && [ -n "$total_output" ] && [ -n "$ctx_size" ]; then total_used=$((total_input + total_output)); used_k=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.0f\", $total_used/1000}"); ctx_k=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.0f\", $ctx_size/1000}"); used_pct_int=$(printf "%.0f" "$used_pct"); context_info=$(printf '\033[36m[%sk/%sk (%s%%)]\033[0m ' "$used_k" "$ctx_k" "$used_pct_int"); fi; printf '\033[35m🍎\033[0m %s/ %s%s%s' "$dir" "$model_info" "$git_info" "$context_info"
